title: Monitoring stack
description: Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, the exporters and Telegraf (C9800 telemetry) on the backends mon01/mon02 (Prometheus HA pair, Alertmanager cluster), and the logging stack (Loki rings, ingest, S3 flushes, Alloy).

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (prometheus_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "Prometheus", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (alertmanager_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "Alertmanager", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (grafana_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "Grafana", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (blackbox_exporter_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "blackbox_exporter", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (snmp_exporter_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "snmp_exporter", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (node_exporter_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "node_exporter", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (frr_exporter_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "frr_exporter", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (loki_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "Loki", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (alloy_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "Alloy", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (version) (cortex_build_info), "version", "not reported", "version", ""), "component", "Mimir", "", "")

panels.title: Head series
panels.description: Per Prometheus replica: both scrape the same targets, so they should be close.

panels.title: TSDB size
panels.description: Blocks + WAL + head chunks per replica. Retention is capped by time and size in monitoring-config.

panels.title: Backend disk free
panels.description: Free space on each backend VM's root filesystem, where the Prometheus and InfluxDB data live.

panels.title: Rule evaluation failures
panels.description: In the selected time range.

panels.title: Notifications dropped / errors
panels.description: In the selected range: alerts Prometheus dropped (not delivered), and alerts in failed sends to an Alertmanager (counted per Alertmanager, so one failure to both counts twice).

panels.title: Targets by job
panels.description: Scrape targets per job. Down targets are mostly hosts that don't run an exporter yet.

panels.title: Rule group evaluation
panels.description: A group whose duration nears its interval misses evaluations.

panels.title: Remote write to Mimir
panels.description: Both replicas send everything; Mimir's HA tracker keeps one replica's samples (the other's are accepted and discarded, not failed). Lag: newest sample appended vs newest sent.

panels.title: Mimir / haproxy
panels.description: Mimir and haproxy (S3 to the RGWs) on mim01-03. Prometheus pushes to the VIP 10.13.11.103.

panels.title: Ring members ACTIVE
panels.description: ACTIVE members of each Mimir ring, as seen by the Mimir that sees fewest. 3 = all Mimir VMs.

panels.title: Accepted Prometheus replica
panels.description: The HA tracker keeps one replica's samples (label __replica__) and drops the other's. It fails over when the elected replica sends nothing for 30 s.

panels.title: Write problems
panels.description: In the time range: samples Mimir rejected (limits, out of order; not the HA dedup), TSDB blocks that failed to upload to S3, samples Prometheus gave up sending.

panels.title: Samples received / deduplicated
panels.description: Samples/s at the distributors: accepted from the elected replica, dropped from the other one, and anything rejected.

panels.title: Active series
panels.description: Series each ingester holds (RF 3: every ingester has all of them). The per-tenant limit is metrics_settings.max_series (300k).

panels.title: Prometheus remote_write
panels.description: Both Prometheus replicas send everything; Mimir keeps one copy.

panels.title: remote_write lag
panels.description: How far each Prometheus is behind in sending to Mimir. It grows while Mimir is unreachable and drains from the WAL afterwards (alert PrometheusRemoteWriteBehind).

panels.title: Blocks to S3 and compaction
panels.description: Each ingester ships a 2 h block every 2 h; the compactor merges them and applies retention (396 d).

panels.title: Query latency (p95)
panels.description: Grafana's queries through the query-frontend (only while someone views a dashboard).

panels.title: S3 operations
panels.description: Requests to the RGWs through each Mimir VM's haproxy.

panels.title: Patroni / etcd / exporters
panels.description: Patroni REST API, etcd, postgres_exporter and haproxy (S3 to the RGWs) on pg01-03.

panels.title: Leader
panels.description: The member that holds Patroni's leader key and the VIP 10.13.11.104 (keepalived checks /primary). None or two: alert PatroniNoLeader.

panels.title: Members
panels.description: 3 / 2 / 3 / 1 when healthy.

targets.expr: sum(patroni_replica{job="patroni"} == 1 and on (host) patroni_postgres_streaming{job="patroni"} == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Timeline / backups
panels.description: The timeline grows by one per failover/switchover. WAL is archived to S3 (pgBackRest) at least every archive_timeout (300 s) when Grafana writes; a full backup runs daily on the leader (PITR 14 days).

panels.title: etcd leader changes
panels.description: In the time range, summed over the members.

panels.title: Role
panels.description: Which member led when: a failover shows up as the green bar moving.

panels.title: Replication lag
panels.description: WAL bytes each replica has not replayed yet. Past maximum_lag_on_failover (1 MiB) it can't become leader (alert PatroniReplicaLag).

targets.expr: scalar(max(patroni_xlog_location{job="patroni"} and on (host) patroni_primary{job="patroni"} == 1)) - (patroni_xlog_replayed_location{job="patroni"} and on (host) patroni_replica{job="patroni"} == 1)

panels.title: Transactions and connections
panels.description: Grafana's database: only the leader takes writes; replicas show 0 commits.

panels.title: WAL archiving
panels.description: Only the leader archives. Failures mean pgBackRest can't reach S3 (alert PostgresWALArchiveFailing).

panels.title: etcd
panels.description: Slow fsyncs or peer round trips cause leader elections (Ceph RBD latency shows up here).

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: The cluster members share alerts and silences: the highest member's count.

panels.title: Cluster
panels.description: Members each Alertmanager sees in its gossip cluster (2 = both backends, over the ha_monitor VLAN), and which backend holds the keepalived VIPs 10.5.11.102/10.13.11.102 (2 = both).

panels.title: Alerts received
panels.description: Per second, from both Prometheus replicas and the Loki ruler (each sends to every member).

panels.title: Notifications by integration
panels.description: Everything routes to the null receiver for now, so this stays at 0.

panels.title: Grafana
panels.description: Both Grafanas share one Postgres database, so these are the same on each.

panels.title: Datasource requests
panels.description: Queries Grafana sends to its datasources (only while someone views a dashboard).

panels.title: Database connections
panels.description: Connections from each Grafana to its Postgres (Patroni on pg01-03, through the VIP 10.13.11.104 on the leader).

panels.title: Loki / Alloy / haproxy
panels.description: Loki and haproxy (S3 to the RGWs) on loki01-03, Alloy on every VM that ships logs.

panels.title: Ring members ACTIVE
panels.description: ACTIVE members of each Loki ring, as seen by the Loki that sees fewest. 3 = all log VMs.

panels.title: Ring health
panels.description: Unhealthy ring members (missed heartbeats), memberlist gossip members (VLAN 214), and the fewest Ceph RGWs any monitoring VM's haproxy (loki, mim, pg) sees UP.

panels.title: Flush failures
panels.description: In the time range: chunk flushes to S3 that failed, entries Alloy gave up on, syslog lines Alloy couldn't parse.

panels.title: Lines received (distributors)
panels.description: Lines/s each Loki's distributor accepts (pushes land on the VIP holder, or the local Loki for each log VM's own Alloy).

panels.title: Alloy: entries sent / syslog received
panels.description: Per Alloy: entries pushed to Loki, syslog lines received (log VMs; the VIP holder gets the devices), and drops.

panels.title: Chunks flushed to S3 (RGW)
panels.description: Chunk flushes by reason (idle, max_age, full, synced). With RF 3 every ingester flushes the same chunks.

panels.title: S3 requests
panels.description: Requests to the RGWs through the local haproxy, by operation and HTTP status.

panels.title: Ingester streams and flush queue
panels.description: Streams held in memory, and chunks waiting to be flushed (should drain to 0).

panels.title: Telegraf: metrics received
panels.description: Metrics per second from each Telegraf input; cisco_telemetry_mdt is the C9800s' gRPC dial-out (one metric per YANG list entry per push), 0 for long fires WlcTelemetryStopped; pvestatd is every PVE node's pvestatd (each Prometheus scrapes its own backend's Telegraf), 0 for long fires PveMetricsStopped.

panels.title: Telegraf: InfluxDB writes
panels.description: Metrics each Telegraf wrote to its InfluxDB (bucket wlc); drops and errors only show when non-zero.

panels.title: Telegraf: output buffer
panels.description: Metrics waiting to be written. It fills up while InfluxDB is unreachable; past the limit Telegraf drops the oldest.

panels.title: InfluxDB
panels.description: InfluxDB answering its /metrics on each backend (alert TargetDown).

panels.title: InfluxDB: points written
panels.description: Points stored per second (the WLC Telegraf; Proxmox writes here until 2026-11-13); errors, drops and timeouts only show when non-zero. Both backends should write about the same.

panels.title: InfluxDB: queries
panels.description: Flux queries (Grafana's wireless dashboards) and their p95 duration.

panels.title: InfluxDB: disk
panels.description: TSM shard files and the write-ahead log, all buckets.

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: CPU seconds per second (1 = one core).
